* Abstract interface implemented by Protocol Message objects.
 *
 * @author wink@google.com Wink Saville

methods.name: public int getCachedSize()
methods.comment:
* Get the number of bytes required to encode this message.
     * Returns the cached size or calls getSerializedSize which
     * sets the cached size. This is used internally when serializing
     * so the size is only computed once. If a member is modified
     * then this could be stale call getSerializedSize if in doubt.

methods.name: public int getSerializedSize()
methods.comment:
* Computes the number of bytes required to encode this message.
     * The size is cached and the cached result can be retrieved
     * using getCachedSize().

methods.name: protected int computeSerializedSize()
methods.comment:
* Computes the number of bytes required to encode this message. This does not update the
     * cached size.

methods.name: public void writeTo(CodedOutputByteBufferNano output) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Serializes the message and writes it to {@code output}.
     *
     * @param output the output to receive the serialized form.
     * @throws IOException if an error occurred writing to {@code output}.

methods.name: public abstract MessageNano mergeFrom(CodedInputByteBufferNano input) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Parse {@code input} as a message of this type and merge it with the
     * message being built.

methods.name: public static final byte[] toByteArray(MessageNano msg)
methods.comment:
* Serialize to a byte array.
     * @return byte array with the serialized data.

methods.name: public static final void toByteArray(MessageNano msg, byte[] data, int offset, int length)
methods.comment:
* Serialize to a byte array starting at offset through length. The
     * method getSerializedSize must have been called prior to calling
     * this method so the proper length is know.  If an attempt to
     * write more than length bytes OutOfSpaceException will be thrown
     * and if length bytes are not written then IllegalStateException
     * is thrown.

methods.name: public static final T mergeFrom(T msg, final byte[] data) throws InvalidProtocolBufferNanoException
methods.comment:
* Parse {@code data} as a message of this type and merge it with the
     * message being built.

methods.name: public static final T mergeFrom(T msg, final byte[] data, final int off, final int len) throws InvalidProtocolBufferNanoException
methods.comment:
* Parse {@code data} as a message of this type and merge it with the
     * message being built.

methods.name: public static final boolean messageNanoEquals(MessageNano a, MessageNano b)
methods.comment:
* Compares two {@code MessageNano}s and returns true if the message's are the same class and
     * have serialized form equality (i.e. all of the field values are the same).

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment:
* Returns a string that is (mostly) compatible with ProtoBuffer's TextFormat. Note that groups * (which are deprecated) are not serialized with the correct field name. * *

This is implemented using reflection, so it is not especially fast nor is it guaranteed * to find all fields if you have method removal turned on for proguard.

methods.name: public MessageNano clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException
methods.comment: * Provides support for cloning. This only works if you specify the generate_clone method.
